sar.narrative: On 2016-11-22, unauthorized activity was identified on card C07671-K2 belonging to customer C07671. Transaction 3526826 totaling $35.66 was executed without cardholder authorization. Graph traversal confirmed behavioral divergence and device anomaly consistent with card not present fraud. The cardholder confirmed the charge was fraudulent. Total exposure: $35.66. Card blocked and reissued; connected identifiers placed under monitoring.
